title: Sample Senior Citizen Social Security Pension
shortDescription: Monthly financial assistance for senior citizens from low-income households to ensure dignity and basic livelihood security.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹2,000 per month into bank account
Free health screening at designated primary health centers
Priority assistance at district social welfare offices
documentsRequired: Age proof (Birth Certificate / Voter ID / School certificate)
Proof of residence in Karnataka (Ration Card or Utility Bill)
Income certificate issued by Revenue Department (Tahsildar)

kn.title: ಮಾದರಿ ಹಿರಿಯ ನಾಗರಿಕರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಭದ್ರತಾ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ
kn.shortDescription: ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆದಾಯ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಹಿರಿಯ ನಾಗರಿಕರಿಗೆ ಗೌರವಯುತ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಬೆಂಬಲ ನೀಡುವ ಮಾಸಿಕ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
benefits: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ₹1,200 ರಿಂದ ₹2,000 ನೇರ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ
ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ತಪಾಸಣೆ
ತಾಲೂಕು ಸಮಾಜ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಇಲಾಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆದ್ಯತಾ ಸೇವೆ

hi.title: नमूना वरिष्ठ नागरिक सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन
hi.shortDescription: कम आय वाले परिवारों के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए सम्मानजनक जीवन यापन हेतु मासिक वित्तीय सहायता।
benefits: बैंक खाते में ₹1,200 से ₹2,000 प्रति माह प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण (DBT)
प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्रों पर निःशुल्क स्वास्थ्य जांच
जिला समाज कल्याण कार्यालयों में प्राथमिकता सहायता

title: Sample Rural Artisan & Traditional Weaver Support
shortDescription: Equipment grants, raw material subsidy, and craft preservation stipend for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
benefits: One-time tool-kit subsidy up to ₹15,000
Subsidized working capital loan with 5% interest subvention
Free marketing access in state handicraft exhibitions
documentsRequired: Artisan Pehchan Card or Handicraft board registration

kn.title: ಮಾದರಿ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಕುಶಲಕರ್ಮಿ ಮತ್ತು ನೇಕಾರರ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹ ಯೋಜನೆ
kn.shortDescription: ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕುಶಲಕರ್ಮಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಲಕರಣೆ ಅನುದಾನ, ಕಚ್ಚಾ ವಸ್ತು ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಲೆ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಗೌರವಧನ.
benefits: ರೂ. 15,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಉಪಕರಣ ಕಿಟ್ ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿ
ಶೇಕಡಾ 5 ರ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಸಾಲ
ರಾಜ್ಯ ಕರಕುಶಲ ಮೇಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ ಅವಕಾಶ

hi.title: नमूना ग्रामीण कारीगर व बुनकर सहायता योजना
hi.shortDescription: पारंपरिक कारीगरों और शिल्पकारों के लिए उपकरण अनुदान, कच्चा माल सब्सिडी और आजीविका सहायता।
benefits: ₹15,000 तक का एकमुश्त टूल-किट अनुदान
5% ब्याज छूट के साथ रियायती कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण
राज्य हस्तशिल्प प्रदर्शनियों में निःशुल्क स्टॉल

rules.label: Annual income in low or lower-middle bracket
Occupation verified as traditional artisan or craftsperson

title: Sample Higher Education Merit & Need Scholarship
shortDescription: Annual tuition reimbursement and book allowance for post-secondary students pursuing undergraduate and technical diplomas.
benefits: Annual fee support up to ₹25,000 directly credited to institution/student
Books and stationery allowance of ₹3,000 per academic year
Mentorship and skill certification test fee reimbursement
documentsRequired: Current college admission confirmation or fee receipt

kn.title: ಮಾದರಿ ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಕ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ
kn.shortDescription: ಪದವಿ ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
benefits: ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ₹25,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಶುಲ್ಕ ನೆರವು
ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮತ್ತು ಲೇಖನ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ₹3,000 ಭತ್ಯೆ
ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ ತರಬೇತಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ

hi.title: नमूना उच्च शिक्षा मेधावी एवं जरूरतमंद छात्रवृत्ति
hi.shortDescription: स्नातक और तकनीकी डिप्लोमा छात्रों के लिए वार्षिक शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं पुस्तक भत्ता।
benefits: प्रति वर्ष ₹25,000 तक की शिक्षण शुल्क सहायता
₹3,000 का वार्षिक पुस्तक एवं अध्ययन सामग्री भत्ता
कौशल प्रमाणन परीक्षा शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति

rules.label: Family income in low or lower-middle bracket

title: Sample Maternal & Infant Nutrition Support Scheme
shortDescription: Nutritional kits and cash assistance for expectant and lactating mothers to combat malnutrition and encourage hospital deliveries.
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹6,000 in three tranches linked to health checkups
Free supplementary nutrition kit containing fortified pulses, oil, and iron syrups
Free transport to taluk hospital for institutional childbirth
documentsRequired: Mother and Child Tracking card (MCH / Thayi card)
Bank account details seeded with beneficiary name

kn.title: ಮಾದರಿ ಮಾತೃ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಶು ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕಾಂಶ ನೆರವು ಯೋಜನೆ
kn.shortDescription: ಗರ್ಭಿಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಲುಣಿಸುವ ತಾಯಂದಿರಿಗೆ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಆಹಾರ ಕಿಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ.
benefits: ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ತಪಾಸಣೆಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ₹6,000 ನಗದು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹ
ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಆಹಾರ ಕಿಟ್ ಉಚಿತ ವಿತರಣೆ
ಹೆರಿಗೆಗಾಗಿ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಆಂಬ್ಯುಲೆನ್ಸ್ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ

hi.title: नमूना मातृ एवं शिशु पोषण सहायता योजना
hi.shortDescription: गर्भवती और धात्री माताओं के लिए स्वास्थ्य जांच से जुड़ी पोषण सामग्री एवं नकद सहायता।
benefits: नियमित स्वास्थ्य जांच पर ₹6,000 की तीन किस्तों में नकद सहायता
दालें, तेल एवं आयरन सप्लीमेंट युक्त निःशुल्क पोषण किट
संस्थागत प्रसव हेतु निःशुल्क एम्बुलेंस सेवा

rules.label: Beneficiary is a woman or mother

title: Sample Universal Family Health Protection Cover
shortDescription: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover up to ₹5 Lakh per eligible family per year across empaneled hospitals.
benefits: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers pre-existing diseases from day one
3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization medicine expenses
documentsRequired: Family ration card or verified identity card
Aadhaar enrollment acknowledgment or voter ID
Medical recommendation / doctor note for elective procedures

title: Sample Affordable Pucca Housing Assistance
shortDescription: Subsidized construction assistance and interest subsidy for homeless or kutcha-house dwelling families in semi-urban and rural areas.
benefits: Direct grant of ₹1,50,000 in 4 milestone stages for house construction
Additional ₹12,000 assistance for hygienic toilet construction
90 days of guaranteed wage employment support under rural employment guarantee
documentsRequired: Land ownership document or patta in female family head's name (or joint)
Proof of currently living in non-pucca/kutcha shelter

title: Sample Small & Marginal Farmer Crop Protection & Input Support
shortDescription: Direct financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year paid in three installments to smallholder farmers for procurement of seeds and bio-fertilizers.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank account in 3 installments of ₹2,000
Discounted seed kits and soil health card advisory services
Access to subsidized solar water pump installation schemes
documentsRequired: Land holding records (RTC / Pahani document <= 2 hectares)

title: Sample Youth Vocational Skill & Apprenticeship Scheme
shortDescription: Free industry-recognized vocational certification programs with a monthly stipend during apprenticeship for youth seeking formal employment.
benefits: 100% free technical skill courses in IT, logistics, healthcare, and green energy
Monthly apprenticeship stipend of ₹4,500 for up to 6 months
Direct placement assistance with partner employers

title: Sample Assistive Devices & Livelihood Grant for Persons with Disabilities
shortDescription: Free distribution of motorized tricycles, hearing aids, braille kits, and seed capital for micro-enterprises run by individuals with disabilities.
benefits: Customized assistive equipment and mobility aids distributed free of charge
One-time self-employment seed capital grant up to ₹25,000
Free travel concession on state public transport buses
documentsRequired: Unique Disability ID (UDID) card or Disability Medical Certificate (40%+ benchmark)

title: Sample Women Self-Help Group (SHG) Micro-Enterprise Revolving Fund
shortDescription: Interest-free revolving funds and collateral-free enterprise credit to women self-help groups starting collective food processing or tailoring businesses.
benefits: Revolving fund of ₹15,000 per eligible SHG group
Collateral-free group enterprise loan up to ₹2,00,000 with 4% prompt repayment incentive
Packaging and branding training from Karnataka Rural Development Institute
documentsRequired: SHG registration resolution and minutes book
Bank passbook of SHG joint account
KYC documents of group office bearers

title: Sample Senior Citizen Day-Care & Geriatric Wellness Grant
shortDescription: Community wellness centers providing recreational spaces, physical therapy, and daily nutritious snacks for elderly citizens living alone or with family.
benefits: Free access to community recreation center and yoga/physiotherapy classes
Daily fortified morning snack and herbal tea
Free bi-weekly geriatric doctor consultation and prescription monitoring

title: Sample Primary School Girl-Child Education Retention Stipend
shortDescription: Bicycle distribution and conditional cash transfer for families with school-going daughters to prevent dropouts during transition from middle to high school.
benefits: Free standard bicycle for students traveling more than 2 km to government school
Annual retention stipend of ₹3,000 credited to mother's account upon 80% attendance
Free set of uniforms and textbooks
documentsRequired: School enrollment certificate signed by headmaster
Student and mother's joint bank account details
